OpenAI Engineer Arrested for Alleged Hidden Recording Device

An engineer at OpenAI, identified as a Saudi national, was arrested at the company's San Francisco headquarters after a hidden recording device was allegedly discovered in an executive meeting room. The engineer's lawyer stated that the allegations are "wholly out of character" and that the engineer's prepaid flight to Saudi Arabia was unrelated to the incident.
